hero.heading: We build a device's mechanics, electronics, and software in one room. Our founder is a doctor.

su-banyosu.name: Laboratory water bath
su-banyosu.tagline: Mechanical, electronics, and embedded software in one product.
su-banyosu.description: A laboratory water bath designed to hold samples at a constant temperature. The enclosure, heating control, and interface were all designed by the same team — nothing outsourced, from mechanics to embedded software.

dijital-patoloji.name: Digital pathology software
dijital-patoloji.tagline: Imaging, annotation, and case management for the pathologist's review.
dijital-patoloji.description: AhtaPatoloji lets you upload whole-slide images from the scanner and review, annotate, and manage cases. It doesn't make the call — it makes the pathologist's review easier.

about.paragraph: Our founder is a physician — who also understands software, electronics, and mechanical design, and gets hands-on with the technical side of the device. The team is made up of engineers he's known for a long time. We're based in Ankara, newly founded. We build a device from mechanics to application software in one room, without outsourcing.

kvkk.title: KVKK Notice
kvkk.legalReviewNote: This is a draft — it must be reviewed by legal counsel before publishing.
body: This notice is prepared by Ahtapot Tıbbi Teknolojiler A.Ş. ("the Company") as the data controller under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK").
The name, email, organization, and message you share through the contact form are processed to evaluate your request and get back to you.
Your data isn't stored in a database — the form is delivered directly by email and used only to respond to your request.
Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, learn the purpose of processing, and request correction or deletion.
You can send these requests in writing to the address in our Contact section.
